_what: The words of the Get started screen's own actions (send paths /work/api/setup/retry, /restart and /stop), moved with their rules from the retired repository src/account-routes.mjs `actions` (tag before-worker-retire, b6ae0ebf81, lines 510-535). The words of a step finished on the screen (setup/complete) are in setup-policy.json (complete_here.missing, complete_here.said, words.finished_elsewhere).
stop_needs_a_run: Choose the setup run to stop.
stop_not_verified: The stop could not be verified. Check setup again before retrying.
stopped: Further setup steps are stopped. Already started work may still finish or have effects.
stop_reason: Stopped by the person from the setup screen.
restart_not_done: Setup has not restarted. Check its current state and try again.
restarted: Setup is ready to continue in your AI. Its earlier results are kept.
